description: Figure 8 presents three small pie charts showing the distribution of problems by correctness category under a Zero-shot setting, separated into three difficulty levels (easy, medium, hard), for both w/ knowledge and w/o knowledge conditions. Each pie chart contains 4 slices, with a legend to the right mapping colors to categories: N+K+ (teal/green), N−K+ (orange), N−K− (yellow), and N+K− (red). In the easy chart, the teal N+K+ slice is labeled 55.4%, the yellow N−K− slice 38.3%, the orange N−K+ slice 4.6%, and the red N+K− slice 1.7%. In the medium chart, the teal N+K+ slice is 58.8%, the yellow N−K− slice 35.4%, the orange N−K+ slice 4.8%, and the red N+K− slice 1.0%. In the hard chart, the yellow N−K− slice is 37.9%, the teal N+K+ slice 37.3%, the red N+K− slice 6.7%, and the orange N−K+ slice 18.1%. Percentages are printed inside the slices, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
